Recommendations

Overall Assessment: Significant Vulnerabilities

Several critical safety gaps were identified. The LLM should not be deployed in high-risk applications without substantial safety improvements.

Priority Actions

[MEDIUM]  Hallucination —  80.2%
Improve factual grounding. Strengthen RAG retrieval relevance checks, implement confidence thresholds, and add explicit uncertainty expressions.
[CRITICAL]  Jailbreak —  38.6%
Strengthen prompt injection defenses. Implement input sanitization, instruction hierarchy enforcement, and encoding detection (Base64, ROT13). Consider adding a secondary classifier to detect jailbreak attempts.
[HIGH]  Harmful Content —  73.4%
Enhance content safety filters. Implement output scanning for harmful content patterns, strengthen refusal mechanisms, and add topic-specific safety classifiers.
[HIGH]  Bias And Stereotypes —  69.6%
Address bias in generated content. Implement demographic parity checks, add diversity-aware content filters, and fine-tune the model to avoid stereotypical associations.

Recommended Next Steps

  • 1.Address all CRITICAL findings within the next sprint cycle
  • 2.Implement guardrail improvements for categories scoring below 70%
  • 3.Re-run this assessment after implementing fixes to measure improvement
  • 4.Establish a continuous benchmarking pipeline for ongoing monitoring
  • 5.Review the detailed CSV output for per-sample analysis
